item.title: I Cant find the fonts " AR JULIAN " Please Help!!!
item.description:
I lost the fonts AR Julian when my computer crashed and can not find it anywhere… It is used for my company name and can be seen at www.national-electrical.com

No one in the sign business can find it, nor the web. If anyone knows anything about it or a different name used for it please let me know.
Thank you very much…
Paul
